# Meemaw - French Dictation App

Meemaw is an iOS application designed to make learning French spelling and grammar fun, stress-free, and engaging for kids, students, and language learners.

## Core Philosophy
- Positive reinforcement instead of punishing red ink.
- A vibrant Neo-Brutalist / Pop-Art aesthetic.
- Gamified learning with an expansive database covering levels from Apprentice to Master.

## Features
- 8 Exclusive Game Modes (Quick Dictation, Marathon, Grammar Rules, Detective, Anagrams, Crazy Dictation, etc.)
- Offline speech recognition and localized rules explanation.
- Progress tracking with XP and leveling system.

## Availability
Available on iOS. Download on the App Store via https://meemaw.app/
